name: matched-control-v1
arithmetic: Choose the CNN from the explicit operation ledger before training. Match nominal arithmetic within 1%; report sparse/dense padding, transforms, precision and measured latency separately.
selection: Equal three-rate screen for both families; rank final validation KL+value MSE, retain every failure. Confirm each selected rate with seeds 1/2/3 and a longer equal exposure horizon before any strength claim.
existing_trial: Adopt the completed tpu-v0-b2048-lr003-s1 fly trial as the 0.003 point; its final 2048-position validation is already known. No CNN learning result has been observed at registration.
scope: First matched comparison under this declared tuning budget, not proof of globally optimal tuning or a connectome advantage. Earlier CPU engineering/optimizer screens are separate and reported.
